mutant_applied.description: Replaced the `unless perm in permissions do raise CompileError … end` block inside the for comprehension in defmanifest/1 with `:ok` (a no-op)
mutant_applied.applied_by: TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR independently — edit tool directly on lib/letflow/modules/module.ex
mutant_applied.before:
for {_role, perms} <- role_grants, perm <- perms do
  unless perm in permissions do
    raise CompileError, ...
  end
end
mutant_applied.after:
# MUTANT: compile-time check disabled — permission validation removed
for {_role, perms} <- role_grants, perm <- perms do
  :ok
end
